visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with an outdoor shot of a burger shop called 'Fabao' featuring a rustic wooden counter and hanging menu signs. A Caucasian man with short light brown hair and a black t-shirt is visible behind the counter, smiling toward the camera. (2) A close-up focuses on the man as he speaks and gestures enthusiastically with both hands; his arms feature visible tattoos and he is wearing a black branded t-shirt. The background consists of light wood-paneled walls and a ceiling fan spinning slowly overhead. (3) The camera shifts to a top-down view of a large metal griddle where several round beef patties are sizzling and releasing steam. Gloved hands use metal spatulas to flip and press the meat, while a clear shaker adds seasoning granules across the surface. (4) The sequence continues with detailed food assembly where a hand in a black glove spreads a creamy orange sauce onto a toasted bun half. Layers of melted yellow cheese, thick bacon strips, grilled onions, sliced tomatoes, lettuce, and crushed yellow chips are carefully piled high. (5) A finished, massive double-patty burger is showcased on a wooden tray with a basket of fries in the blurred background; the lighting is bright and emphasizes the glistening meat and fresh vegetables. A knife held by gloved hands cuts through the burger vertically, revealing the interior textures. (6) A different burger variant is shown with lighter-colored meat patties being grilled and topped with cheese, following a similar assembly process with colorful toppings. Side dishes including golden French fries and a small container of sauce are presented in a close-up shot. (7) The focus moves to a refrigerator stocked with dark bottles labeled with colorful graphics; a bottle is opened and a light amber liquid is poured into a clear glass. A display case reveals various desserts including square brownies with toasted marshmallows and colorful macarons with character designs. (8) The final shots show the interior of the shop with simple wooden seating, a TV mounted on the wall, and posters. A large text overlay appears in the center listing addresses and contact information while the storefront is shown one last time.
